unobserved_field_encoding: 00000000 with corresponding observation flag unset; zero is not proof of an observed value
immutability: Header/source identity immutable; snapshot field formatting occurs after attempt into owned log buffer; descriptor and PCM never reused for log storage

outcome_semantics.context_changed: singleton address or bound state-object handle changed
outcome_semantics.state_invalid: state query returned -1; raw value remains ffffffff
outcome_semantics.buffer_changed: after own active observation, PCM pointer or byte count changed
outcome_semantics.unexpected_phase: other unexpected phase, including 4 or outside 0..4
outcome_semantics.audioctrl_missing: AudioCtrl singleton [0x10234] or its state-object handle +4 is null
outcome_semantics.audioctrl_state_invalid: AudioCtrl state query returned -1 (bad magic, raw ffffffff)
outcome_semantics.audioctrl_not_ready: AudioCtrl state query returned valid state other than 1
outcome_semantics.audio_ic_unready: AudioIC singleton [0x10240] is null or initialized flag +4 != 1
outcome_semantics.icu_cache_unready: fixed ICU cache [0x19158+4] is 0 or kind [0x19158+0] not in {0, 1}
outcome_semantics.parameter_table_missing: selected direct parameter pointer [0x28c78] (AK) or [0x28c84] (VAIF) is null

phase_seen_mask_semantics: Cumulative post-submit observations of phases 0..4 across observation attempts; independent of final PHASE_AFTER validity. Nonzero requires OBSERVE_POLLS >= 1. Earlier evidence survives later missing/changed context.
